Delicious. Juicy. Soulful
Nov 2024 • Couples
We want to express our great gratitude for the wonderful evenings at this restaurant. We ended up in Muinh after spending not the first week in Vietnam, we went to different establishments , chose "Chaihan 312" based on the reviews and did not regret at all. It is worth noting the varied menu, the cleanliness of the restaurant (!!!) and the heartfelt attitude towards the guests. In the restaurant you can also order seafood for any taste, took shrimp in coconut milk and scallops - fresh, tender. Separately we want to note mantas, homemade patties, chebureks, it is this kind of cuisine you begin to miss being in captivity of rice and noodles. The restaurant is always full of guests, but no one is left behind. 
Thank you very much Yule for the dumplings “without B” (without broth), and Askhat for the tender barbecue. We'll definitely come back here and more than once, it's nice that in a place so far from home we've felt at home. Thank you!
